title: G1a: every run row carries goal_id and normalised token buckets (uncached input, cache read, cache write, output, reasoning) through one bus.normalize_usage(); Jev usage rows carry task and goal ids
spec:
Scout T-0261 (goal/T-0260): bus.log_run appends any fields (bus.py about line 206); spawn.py logs usd, turns, input/output/cache_read/cache_creation tokens for Claude runs (about line 171); executor.py Codex rows carry input_tokens, output_tokens and cached_input_tokens mapped to cache_read_input_tokens, never usd and never reasoning (executor._tokens about line 65 and its three log_run calls); jev._log_usage rows (runs/jev/<date>.jsonl) carry caller, input_tokens, model, latency_ms, ok, votes but no task or goal id (jev.py about line 151). Nothing in the repo mentions reasoning tokens.
Change:
1. bus.normalize_usage(provider, usage) -> dict with keys input_uncached_tokens, cache_read_tokens, cache_write_tokens, output_tokens, reasoning_tokens, total_tokens. Claude usage: input_tokens is uncached input, cache_read_input_tokens and cache_creation_input_tokens map to the cache buckets, output_tokens to output, reasoning 0 unless a reasoning field exists. Codex --json usage: input_tokens includes cached_input_tokens, so input_uncached = input_tokens - cached_input_tokens, cache_read = cached_input_tokens, cache_write 0, output = output_tokens, reasoning = reasoning_output_tokens if present (kept as its own bucket, not added again to output; document the assumption that Codex folds reasoning into output_tokens and record reasoning_output_tokens only as an informational bucket that total_tokens excludes). total_tokens = input_uncached + cache_read + cache_write + output.
2. bus.log_run: when a task id is given, add goal_id = the task's parent (or the task id itself for a goal task) and provider; call sites in spawn.py and executor.py pass the raw usage through normalize_usage and log the normalised keys next to the raw ones (raw keys stay for old readers).
3. jev._log_usage: add task (ORCH_TASK_ID or the caller-supplied task id) and goal_id (parent lookup via bus, fail-open when the bus is unavailable) to every usage row; jev_gate and jev_rank pass the task id they already know.
4. Tests in tests/test_bus.py: test_normalize_usage_claude, test_normalize_usage_codex (cached subtracted, reasoning separate), test_log_run_adds_goal_id; tests/test_jev.py: test_usage_row_has_task_and_goal. Keep every existing test green.
acceptance: a Claude run row and a Codex run row written through spawn.py and executor.py both contain goal_id, provider and the six normalised token keys (proven by tests with monkeypatched subprocess output)
Existing tests pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree

Tests added in tests/test_bus.py and tests/test_jev.py. tests-green.sh wt/T-0264 exited 0 (Planner, 21:33). Note: the call-site proof is by the three-line changes in spawn.py and executor.py plus the normaliser tests, not by a subprocess-mocked integration test (acceptance 3 partially met). Posted by hand.
